dishes.n: Avenue B cart soft pretzels with mustard
dishes.make_ahead: Best baked on the day; shape the pretzels and keep them covered in the fridge up to 4 hours, then boil and bake

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, melted butter and warm water and knead until smooth.
Cover and leave somewhere warm until doubled.
Heat the oven to 220C. Cut the dough into 8, roll each into a long rope and twist into a pretzel.
Boil the water for the bath with the bicarbonate of soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds, then lift onto lined trays.
Brush with the egg, scatter with the coarse salt and bake until deep brown.
Serve warm with the yellow and wholegrain mustard in bowls.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll and chill the logs up to 1 day ahead, wrapped; slice and bake just before serving

steps.text: Spread the pastry sheets with the pesto and scatter over the parmesan and cheddar.
Roll each sheet up tightly from the long side.
Chill so the logs slice cleanly. Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut into 1.5cm rounds, lay flat on lined trays and brush with the egg.
Bake until puffed and golden, then cool a few minutes.

dishes.n: Christmas Eve arroz con pollo for the loft
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and blitz the sofrito up to 2 days ahead; cook the rice on the night

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 3 crushed for the rub, 4 for the sofrito

steps.text: Rub the chicken with the crushed garlic, oregano, cumin, lime juice and salt.
Leave to marinate.
Blitz the onion, both capsicums, the rest of the garlic and the coriander to a rough sofrito.
Brown the chicken skin side down in the olive oil in a wide heavy pot, turning once, then lift out.
Fry the sofrito in the fat until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste, paprika, turmeric and rice.
Pour in the stock, add the bay leaves, sit the chicken on top, cover and simmer gently.
Scatter over the peas and olives, cover off the heat to finish, and serve with the lime wedges.

veg.n: Christmas Eve arroz with mushrooms and chickpeas
veg.make_ahead: Blitz the sofrito up to 2 days ahead; cook the rice on the night

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 3 crushed for the rub, 4 for the sofrito

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the crushed garlic, oregano, cumin, lime juice and salt.
Blitz the onion, both capsicums, the rest of the garlic and the coriander to a rough sofrito.
Brown the mushrooms hard in the olive oil in a wide heavy pot, then lift out.
Fry the sofrito in the pot until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste, paprika, turmeric and rice.
Pour in the stock, add the bay leaves, chickpeas and mushrooms, cover and simmer gently.
Scatter over the peas and olives, cover off the heat to finish, and serve with the lime wedges.

steps.text: Char the chillies and capsicums under the grill, then peel, seed and chop.
Brown the pork in the oil in a heavy pot, add the onion, garlic and cumin and cook until soft.
Add the chillies, capsicum and stock and simmer covered until the pork is tender.
Add the potatoes and simmer until soft.
Serve with warm tortillas, lime and coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days ahead, reheat gently

Soften the onion, garlic and cumin in the oil.
Add the chillies, capsicum, beans, potatoes and stock and simmer until the potatoes are soft.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and chill up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; turn out and dust just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the cornflour into the coconut milk in a saucepan until smooth, then add the sugar, salt and cinnamon stick.
Stir over medium heat until it boils and turns thick and glossy.
Take off the heat, lift out the cinnamon stick and stir in the vanilla. Pour into a lightly oiled mould.

dishes.n: Collins' hot toddy for a loft with no heat
dishes.make_ahead: Simmer the spiced water up to 1 day ahead and reheat; build each mug to order

steps.text: Simmer the water with the cinnamon sticks and cloves.
Put the honey and whisky into 4 heatproof mugs and squeeze in the lemon juice.
Top with the hot spiced water and stir until the honey melts.
Finish each mug with a lemon slice and a piece of the cinnamon stick.

af.n: Collins' hot ginger tea for a loft with no heat
af.make_ahead: Simmer the spiced ginger water up to 1 day ahead and reheat; steep the tea and build each mug to order

steps.text: Simmer the water with the cinnamon sticks, cloves and ginger.
Take off the heat, drop in the tea bags and steep, then lift them out.
Put the honey into 4 heatproof mugs with the lemon juice, pour over the hot tea and stir until the honey melts.
Finish each mug with a lemon slice and a piece of the cinnamon stick.

s.n: Avenue B cart soft pretzels with mustard
s.note: Chewy, dark brown soft pretzels with coarse salt, served warm with yellow and wholegrain mustard
s.how: Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp salt, 30g melted butter and 325ml warm water and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and leave somewhere warm for an hour until doubled. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut the dough into 8, roll each into a 60cm rope and twist into a pretzel. Bring 2l water to the boil with 80g bicarbonate of soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds, then lift onto lined trays. Brush with beaten egg, scatter with coarse salt and bake for 12 to 14 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with yellow mustard and wholegrain mustard.

s.note: Puff pastry rolled with sun-dried tomato pesto, parmesan and cheddar, sliced and baked crisp
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Lay out 2 sheets of thawed puff pastry and spread each with 1.5 tbsp sun-dried tomato pesto. Scatter over 40g grated parmesan and 80g grated cheddar between them, then roll each sheet up tightly from the long side. Chill for 20 minutes so they slice cleanly. Cut into 1.5cm rounds, lay flat on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool a few minutes before serving.

m.n: Christmas Eve arroz con pollo for the loft
m.note: Garlic and lime chicken thighs simmered in yellow sofrito rice with capsicum, green olives and peas
m.how: Rub 8 bone-in chicken thighs with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin, the juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp salt and leave for 30 minutes. Blitz 1 brown onion, 1 green and 1 red capsicum, 4 garlic cloves and a handful of coriander to a rough sofrito. Brown the chicken skin side down in 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide heavy pot for 12 minutes, turning once, then lift out. Fry the sofrito in the fat for 8 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp turmeric and 400g medium grain rice for 3 minutes. Pour in 750ml chicken stock, add 2 bay leaves, sit the chicken on top, cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes. Scatter over 1 cup frozen peas and 100g green olives, cover off the heat for 10 minutes and serve with lime wedges.

w.note: Puerto Rican coconut milk pudding, set cold until it wobbles and dusted with cinnamon
w.how: Whisk 80g cornflour into 800ml coconut milk in a saucepan until smooth, then add 110g caster sugar, a pinch of salt and a cinnamon stick. Stir over medium heat for 12 minutes until it boils and turns thick and glossy. Take off the heat, lift out the cinnamon stick and stir in 1 tsp vanilla extract. Pour into a lightly oiled 1l mould or 4 small cups and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Run a knife round the edge, turn out onto a plate and dust with ground cinnamon.

d.n: Collins' hot toddy for a loft with no heat
d.note: Whisky, honey and lemon with boiling water, steeped with cloves and cinnamon, in mugs
d.how: Boil 800ml water with 2 cinnamon sticks and 8 cloves and simmer for 5 minutes. Put 1 tbsp honey and 40ml whisky into each of 4 heatproof mugs, squeeze in the juice of 1 lemon between them and top with the hot spiced water. Stir until the honey melts and finish each mug with a lemon slice and a piece of cinnamon stick.
